{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the column names and the response variable
print('Column names:', df.columns.tolist())

# Check the unique values in 'arm', 'severity', and 'responded'
print('\nUnique values in arm:', df['arm'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in severity:', df['severity'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in responded:', df['responded'].unique())

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity
filtered_df = df[(df['arm'] == 'CONTROL') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered group
print('\nNumber of CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity:', len(filtered_df))

# Calculate the fraction who responded (responded == 1)
responded_count = filtered_df['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(filtered_df)

print('\nResponded count:', responded_count)
print('\nFraction responded:', fraction_responded)

# Return the fraction as a float
fraction_responded"}
